name: UpperTheory.V.PropA.aBound_of_isTower
source: (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime] (L₀ : Type) [Field L₀] [NumberField L₀] (R : ℕ) (ht : UpperTheory.V.Tower.IsTower l L₀ R) :
obtain ⟨γ, h₁, h₂, h₃⟩ := UpperTheory.V.PropA.genLevel l L₀ ht.mu
exact UpperTheory.V.PropA.aBound_of_descends hP hF hT ht h₂ h₃ (UpperTheory.V.PropA.descends l L₀ ht.mu γ h₁)
show: Let ℓ be prime and let the number field L₀ satisfy the tower conditions for R. Assume global Poitou–Tate duality, local finiteness and local Tate duality. Then the arithmetic lengths on the tower satisfy both estimates of ABound. Centres in the ℓ-adic field bound the length in terms of the distance from the twist. At layer m, the length is also at most the second cohomology length at the reference layer j₀ plus R max(m−j₀,0).
strategy: Choose a cyclotomic generator of the correct level and obtain its descent identity. These are exactly the extra inputs of the preceding conditional tower estimate.

steps.claim: Let ℓ be prime. The tower assumes a totally complex number field L₀, a primitive fourth root in L₀ at ℓ = 2 or a primitive ℓth root at odd ℓ, R ≥ 1, and an ℤℓ-linear surjection ℤℓ^R → X_P. Let c₀ be the maximal ℓ-power root-of-unity depth in L₀. The root hypothesis supplies γ with κ(γ) of exact level c₀ and dense integer powers in the cyclotomic image, as well as a primitive ℓ^c₀-th root in L₀. The root and generator hypotheses give descent. Put j₀ = ⌊log_ℓ R⌋ + 3. The conditional tower estimate gives R integral centres in ℚℓ such that, for every e ≥ 1, the Sha length on any level-m field is at most R(max(m,j₀) + c₀ + B) whenever all centre distances from e are at least ℓ^(−B). On any level-j₀ field, for any algebraic closure and local data D, the assumed global Poitou–Tate duality, local finiteness and local Tate duality bound the reference Sha length by VLen(D,e), the length of H² at twist e + 1. Growth then bounds the level-m Sha length by VLen(D,e) + R max(m − j₀, 0).
steps.snippet:
UpperTheory.V.Win.ABound l R L₀ := by
  obtain ⟨γ, h₁, h₂, h₃⟩ := UpperTheory.V.PropA.genLevel l L₀ ht.mu
  exact UpperTheory.V.PropA.aBound_of_descends hP hF hT ht h₂ h₃ (UpperTheory.V.PropA.descends l L₀ ht.mu γ h₁)

chapterTitle: Twisted cokernels in a cyclotomic tower
